senses.gloss: यशः-काय यशः-काय, m. a body consisting of glory, i. e. glory, Bhartṛ. 2, 21.
यशस्- + पटह यशस्- + पटह, m. a drum.
यष्टि- + प्राण यष्टि- + प्राण, adj. out of breath, Johns. Sel. 21, 105.

यशस् यशस् (for original दशस् = Lat. decus, from a lost vb. दश्, see below),
 I. n.
 1. Glory, Vikr. 11, 17; fame, Pañc. iii. d. 116 (pl.).
 2. Splendour.
 3. Praise.
 II. adj. Renowned, resplendent, Chr. 294, 8 = Rigv. i. 92, 8; superl. यशस्तम, Lass. 101, 9 = Rigv. vii. 16, 4.
 --Comp.
 --Cf. Lat. decere, docere; δοκέω, δόξω, δόγμα, δοκεύω, διδάσκω, δάκτυλος; probably A.S. ta, tah; O.H.G. zêha.

यशस्कर यशस्-कर,
 I. adj., f. री, Rendering famous, Hit. iii. d. 122.
 II. m. A proper name, Rājat. 5, 472.

यशस्य यशस् + य, adj. Bringing reputation, Man. 3, 106.
 --Comp.
यशस्वन्त् यशस् + वन्त्, adj., f. वाति, and युअशस्विन् यशस् + विन्, adj., f. विनी, Famous, Chr. 21, 6 (विन्); Lass. 31, 13 (विन्).

यष्टि यष्टि,
 I. m. and f. (and यष्टी यष्टी, f.),
 1. A staff, a stick, Pañc. 105, 19; 261, 12; Śiś. 9, 39; a perch, Vikr. d. 43; a stem, d. 44; support, Sāv. 5, 89.
 2. A palisade, Man. 9, 285.
 3. A club, Daśak. in Chr. 187, 4.
 4. A string, Vikr. d. 51.
 5. A necklace.
 6. Any creeping plant, Utt. Rāmac. 81, 5.
 7. Liquorice.
 8. A shrub, Siponanthus indica.
 II. m.
 1. A flagstaff.
 2. The arm and forearm.
 --Comp.

यष्टिक यष्टि + क,
 I. m. A bird, the lapwing.
 II. f. का.
 1. A staff, a club.
 2. A necklace.
 3. A pond.
 4. Liquorice.
याष्टीक याष्टीक, i. e. यष्टी + क, m. A warrior armed with a club.
यष्टुकाम यष्टुकाम, i. e. यष्टुम् (infin. of यज्), -काम, adj. Desiring to sacrifice, Rām. 1, 57, 10.
यष्टृ यष्टृ, i. e. यज् + तृ, m. A sacrificer.

यस् यस् (akin to यम्, for यंस्), i. 4, and † 1, Par. To make strenuous and persevering exertion, to endeavour.
 --With the prep. आ आ,
 1. To endeavour, Rām. 2, 14, 62.
 2. To be afflicted, Bhaṭṭ. 6, 69. आयस्त,
 1. Pained, distressed, Rām. 2, 20, 8.
 2. Vexed, angry.
 3. Managed with difficulty.
 4. Hurt.
 5. Thrown.
 6. Sharpened.
 7. Strained, Pañc. v. d. 28.
 --Caus. To torment, Mālav. 32, 7 (Prākṛ.).
 --Comp. ptcple. of the pf. pass. अन्-आयासित, Not practised, Pañc. i. d. 429 (rather अन्-आयास + इत).
 --With प्र प्र, To endeavour, Naiṣ. 1, 125. प्रयस्त. Seasoned, dressed with condiments.
यशस्- + राशि यशस्- + राशि, m. greatness of glory, i. e. a glorious deed, Vikr. 11, 17.
यशस्- + शेष यशस्- + शेष, adj. dead.
